blocks.text: Video Intercom System
Video Intercom Systems for Villas, Apartments & Buildings

Answering a door without knowing who's on the other side is a habit most people have already broken at home with a video doorbell — the same logic applies at a much larger scale for apartment buildings, gated communities, and commercial entrances, where staff or residents need to see and speak with a visitor before granting entry. A video intercom system does exactly that, giving a live video and audio link to the door before anyone opens it.We supply and install video intercom systems across Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Sharjah, and Al Ain, specifying single-unit villa setups through to multi-apartment building systems with centralized management.
Call Now
Why you need a vedio intercom system in UAE

Most residential towers and gated communities across the UAE already rely on some form of controlled entry, but a locked gate or a buzzer that just unlocks on any press doesn't actually tell anyone who's asking to come in — it just removes one barrier without adding any real verification. A video intercom system closes that gap, letting residents or staff see and speak with a visitor through a video intercom before deciding whether to let them through, rather than granting access on trust alone.This matters more in high-density UAE developments than it might in a standalone villa, simply because of scale — a single building entrance might see dozens of deliveries, visitors, and service staff in a day, and manually checking each one at a staffed gate isn't always practical or cost-effective. A video intercom system lets that verification happen at the individual unit level instead, so each resident controls their own entry decisions through their own video intercom rather than relying on a security guard present at every door.
Types of Video Intercom Systems
Villa & Single-Unit Systems

A straightforward door station and indoor monitor pairing, suited to individual homes and villas where one entrance needs coverage without the complexity of a shared building system.Apartment & Building Systems
Apartment & Building Systems

Multi-unit systems route calls from a shared building entrance to the correct individual apartment, often with the ability for residents to answer and release the door from a mobile app as well as an indoor monitor — useful for larger residential buildings where every unit needs its own line to the entrance.
IP Video Intercom

IP-based systems run over a building's network rather than dedicated wiring, making them easier to integrate with existing CCTV, access control, and mobile apps — increasingly the standard choice for new installations where network infrastructure is already in place.
Integration With Access Control

Video intercom systems are often installed alongside access control, so a resident or staff member can grant entry to a visitor via the intercom while the same door remains secured by credential-based access control for authorized residents or staff. We design these systems to work together rather than as separate, disconnected installations at the same entrance.
Installation

Installation covers mounting the outdoor door station, running cabling or configuring the network connection, installing indoor monitors or setting up mobile app access, and integrating with the entrance door lock where required. We test the full call, video, audio, and door release function before handover, confirming the system works end to end rather than just powering on.
Brands We Supply

We supply and install video intercom systems from recognized manufacturers including Hikvision, Akuvox, Comelit, Fermax, and 2N, specifying the platform that best fits each project's scale and integration needs. If your project's specification calls for a particular brand or model, we work to that spec directly rather than substituting a different platform.
